title: Aromatic Crisp Korean Turkey Ham Namul
description: A bitter and crisp Korean dish featuring turkey ham, this namul is a show-off dish that is jain-friendly and perfect for special occasions. It is served on a wooden board and features deep-fry-tod for added crunch.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Deep-fry the diced turkey ham until it is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the turkey ham from the oil and place it on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In a small bowl, whisk together the sesame oil, soy sauce, garlic, and ginger.
Add the chopped green onions, toasted sesame seeds, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the crispy turkey ham to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Arrange the turkey ham namul on a wooden board in a decorative pattern.
Serve the namul immediately and enjoy.
Garnish with additional green onions and toasted sesame seeds if desired.
